literal: virtue having-known matured wisdom-possessors' friendship worth having-known having-considered should-acquire
translation: Recognize the worth of those who know virtue and possess mature wisdom, and carefully secure their friendship.
modern: அறத்தை அறிந்து முதிர்ந்த அறிவை உடையவர்களின் நட்பினை, அதன் அருமையை அறிந்து ஆராய்ந்து பெற்றுக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises on how to choose one's closest companions. The phrase 'aṟaṉ aṟintu mūtta' refers to those who have deeply understood virtue and grown mature in their wisdom. 'Kēṇmai' means friendship or close association. The couplet emphasizes that one should understand the true value of such companionship and deliberately secure it after careful consideration.
